Title: General Availability of the New Azure VMware Solution

Body.Content:
Azure VMware Solution empowers customers to seamlessly extend or migrate their existing on-premises VMware applications to Azure without the cost, effort or risk of re-architecting applications or retooling operations.

  • Watch the Azure VMware Solution Ignite session with Eric Lockard CVP
  • Visit the Azure VMware Solution website and documentation.
